soft_failures.text: Anthropic's Claude now offers voice mode for its Opus and Sonnet models, extending conversational AI into applications like Gmail and Slack.
Librarians are now hosting viral 'Avoiding AI' workshops, helping individuals disable AI features on their devices and understand how to reduce their digital footprint.

synthesis.claim: The increasing sophistication and accessibility of AI voice interfaces, coupled with the growing demand for human-centric digital detox, indicates a bifurcation in the AI landscape: one path towards deeper integration and another towards deliberate disengagement.
